video_title: LeBron Plays Golf with the Akron Fab Five

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James introduces the 3v3 scramble format with his childhood friends
quotes.excerpt: We're going to do a 3v3 scramble, with bragging rights, and we're going to keep you posted.
quotes.quote: What's up y'all, welcome back to the channel. We're here at Portage Country Club in my hometown, our hometown of Akron, Ohio. We're going to do a 3v3 scramble, with bragging rights, and we're going to keep you posted on this now. We're missing two of our guys that we do roll with, Brandon Weems and Dru Joyce, but we love them. And his guys are late, but we're going to get going soon, so y'all stay tuned.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James explains the rules for the 3v3 scramble golf match
quotes.excerpt: We're playing match play, meaning it don't matter how many strokes, whatever the case may be.
quotes.quote: We got a 3v3 scramble. Scramble is basically, we all tee off, whatever y'all decide on the best ball from there, y'all all hit from that same spot all the way up until the ball going into the hole. We're playing match play, meaning it don't matter how many strokes, whatever the case may be. If we get six, y'all get five, y'all won that first hole, y'all are up one.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James outlines the breakfast ball and mulligan rules for the match
quotes.excerpt: You get a breakfast ball on one and ten. If you hit and you get some bullshit, you get to hit again.
quotes.quote: You get a breakfast ball on one and ten. If you hit and you get some bullshit, you get to hit again. Only on one and only on ten, so you get one on the front nine, one on the back nine. And you get one mulligan per team, per team, one on the front nine and the back nine. And they don't carry over though, so if you don't use it, you dead, you lose it.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James gives golf swing advice to Romeo Travis
quotes.excerpt: Don't do like this, because when you do like this, now you're on top of the ball.
quotes.quote: Don't do like this, because when you do like this, now you're on top of the ball. So now you do one like this. You will always be on top of the ball. Once you set, just move your arms and hips. So even if you do your short backswing, you can do like this. That's cool too, for arms and hips.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James reflects on the mental difficulty of golf
quotes.excerpt: I know golf is the hardest sport I've ever done in my life, and the mental aspect.
quotes.quote: I know golf is the hardest sport I've ever done in my life, and the mental aspect when you get up there to hit the ball, we're not taking that for granted. We understand how hard it is, but our boy ain't being an athlete. He just got to be a little bit more, and I'm not -- I got to be more too at times, but he got to lock in. I mean, I know golf is skill, but at some point it becomes about heart.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the team's performance and the back nine
quotes.excerpt: We gifted them a double-or-nothing on one of the holes, so they got back into the game.
quotes.quote: After the turn, we are up 6-2, headed to the back nine. We gifted them a double-or-nothing on one of the holes, so they got back into the game a little bit. But you want to talk about your team performance so far?

quotes.speaker: Romeo Travis
quotes.summary_phrase: Romeo Travis on his performance and getting better
quotes.excerpt: Today's my first time picking up golf clubs in two years, and I was pretty bad.
quotes.quote: We are getting better as the day goes on. I'm not happy about my performance, but I'm trying. Today's my first time picking up golf clubs in two years, and I was pretty bad. Let's be honest, but I ain't going to give up and I'm going to keep swinging. One of these is going to hit, I don't know when, maybe not today, but one of them is going to hit and we are going to keep swinging.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the team's competitive spirit
quotes.excerpt: They are pretty much conceded. I mean, it's 10-2. We have 15. I think they are just playing for respect.
quotes.quote: We just got word from the other team that the match is, they pretty much conceded. I mean, it's 10-2. We have 15. I think they are just playing for respect at this point. They are just playing for respect.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Randy Mims on team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: You got a teammate that's leaving. He came late and he's leaving early.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Who made this decision? You got a teammate that's leaving. He came late and he's leaving early.

text_blocks.speaker: Randy Mims
text_blocks.text: I had to be a father, fellas. I'm sorry about it, man. Daddy duties, man. You know I'll be back.
